description: This file defines the KVIndex annotation used in Apache Spark's key-value store utility. It provides metadata for indexing fields or methods within data objects to facilitate efficient data retrieval and sorting, including options for index naming, parent relationships, and data copying behavior.

classes.name: KVIndex
classes.description: Annotation used to mark fields or methods for indexing in Spark's key-value store, with options for index name, parent index, and data copying.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the name of the index to be created for the annotated entity, defaulting to the natural index name.

methods.name: parent
methods.description: Returns the name of the parent index, if any, to establish relationships between entities.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Indicates whether to copy the data into the index or just store a reference.
